g.text: Two C17 camp lanterns for $84. Oakland is closer to the customer, but the carton ships from Reno.
A browser retry must return the original order. Allocation starts only after the order is durable.
Oakland ranks first on transit time. A live reservation decides whether it can actually ship.
The availability feed is a snapshot. The ledger checks the current quantity and records a hold in one transaction.
A printed label is reversible. The first carrier scan triggers capture and the customer’s tracking update.
